C1629.title: IEEE Academic Research: Impact of Social Engineering Attacks on Metaverse Platforms
C1629.summary: A 2024 IEEE international conference paper investigates social engineering attacks targeting metaverse platforms. The study highlights how vulnerabilities in immersive virtual environments can be exploited, with attackers using social manipulation and authentication attacks to cause psychological and emotional harm to users. The research conducted social engineering attacks using Kali Linux tools

references.title: The Impact of Social Engineering Attacks on the Metaverse Platform
